title: DepotWatch news feed list
description: The news feeds the widget offers out of the box, and at the same time the server-side allowlist the proxy route accepts (see README.md). Configuration only: this file carries no portfolio data and no user data of any kind.

schemaVersion.description: Version of THIS format, not of anything a publisher does.

id.description: Stable and unique. Kebab case. What a muted or disabled source is remembered by in a portfolio file, so renaming one loses that setting.

name.description: The publisher, as it should be credited next to every headline.

language.description: The language the headlines are in, as an ISO 639-1 code.

url.description: The publisher's own RSS or Atom feed. HTTPS only, and never a page that has to be scraped.

homepage.description: Where the feed comes from, for the source list in the settings.

terms.description: The publisher's terms of use, licence or imprint. Required: a source whose conditions nobody can look up does not belong in a shipped list.

description.description: One sentence: what this feed is and roughly how much of it there is.

defaultEnabled.description: Whether the source is on before the user has said anything. Absent means true; false is for a feed that is worth offering but too busy to put in a chronological list by default.
